text:
deploy-bot: Canary check: release 2.7.1 -> us-west-2 slice at 12% breached p95 SLO (460ms > 350ms). Auto-rollback scheduled in 4m unless acknowledged. :warning:

alex.prod: I see p95 spike and a small uptick in 5xxs from model host group transformer-2.

tara.eng: tagging @jen-releases and @sam-ops. There are a couple of VIP routes in the slice; prefer surgical action if possible.

jen-releases: quick options: 1) immediate full rollback to 2.7.0; 2) reduce slice percent to 2% and investigate; 3) flip runtime kernel flag if possible. Thoughts?

sam-ops: can reduce to 2% in ~10s: `releasesctl traffic set --release 2.7.1 --slice us-west-2 --percent 2`. Also we can ack deploy-bot to pause auto-rollback.

alex.prod: please cut to 2% and pause auto-rollback for 30m so eng can triage.

sam-ops: done: `releasesctl traffic set --release 2.7.1 --slice us-west-2 --percent 2` -> applied.

deploy-bot: Manual ack recorded: `ack_by: alex.prod`, hold expires at 1755579576. Auto-rollback suppressed for 30m.

tara.eng: looking at traces: increased tail latency on long-seq prompts. New runtime flag `fused_attn_v2` enabled in this build. Suspect kernel change.

alex.prod: can we flip that flag for this slice without redeploy? If yes, try on a small subset and run synthetic.

jen-releases: command to toggle flag: `releasesctl flag set --release 2.7.1 --name fused_attn_v2 --value false --scope us-west-2` then run quick soak. If OK, ramp. If not, rollback.

sam-ops: initiating flag toggle on `staging-fuse-3` pool for a canary of 200 nodes.

ci-bot: CI synthetic test triggered: 1k requests over 2m against staging-fuse-3. Link: http://ci/shortlink/REL-TST-77

alex.prod: drafting short customer note: "We temporarily reduced rollout in us-west-2 due to elevated latency. We're investigating; no action required." Should we send?

jen-releases: yes, send an initial one-liner to #customer-ops and add a line in release notes. Keep it minimal.

sam-ops: toggle applied to staging-fuse-3. Running synthetic now.

ci-bot: Synthetic run results: p95=300ms (baseline 285ms), no 502s. Sample size small.

tara.eng: good sign. extend hold by @alex.prod another 45m while we validate production subset. Also file REL-5240 to gate fused_attn_v2 behind preflight.

jen-releases: fallback script if toggle fails:
```
releasesctl rollback --from 2.7.1 --to 2.7.0 --regions us-west-2 --mode staged
notify --channel customer-ops --template latency-rollback-short
```

sam-ops: applying flag change for us-west-2 slice now and will ramp to 10% over 12m if stable.

deploy-bot: Noted: `flag_change: fused_attn_v2=false`, `ramp_to: 10% over 12m`, manual ack persists.

ci-bot: small production probe results (first 5m): p95=315ms, error rate steady.

alex.prod: proceeding with 10% ramp. Monitor closely for error ratio and tail lat.

sam-ops: ramp command executed: `releasesctl traffic set --release 2.7.1 --slice us-west-2 --percent 10` -> ramping.

tara.eng: watching APM traces. decode time back near baseline. No immediate regression.

jen-releases: updating release notes: "Canary ramp paused and adjusted in us-west-2 due to transient latency; kernel flag toggled for investigation."

alex.prod: will keep thread open until postmortem tasks created. If anything spikes, we revert to 2.7.0.

deploy-bot: Final: manual suppression in place, no rollback executed. Handoff: REL-5240 (flag gating) and an ops incident INC-1799 for audit. Thread closed.
